# Rules Reference typography

These fonts are bundled for offline use under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.
The adjacent license files contain copyright and license notices.

Source: Google Fonts, commit `6c1dbe27dcf7d817d4b62cec033ba77fa8e2a5ec`.

- Rajdhani Medium (500) and Bold (700), Indian Type Foundry:
  https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/6c1dbe27dcf7d817d4b62cec033ba77fa8e2a5ec/ofl/rajdhani
- Exo 2, Natanael Gama, instantiated at weight 800:
  https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/6c1dbe27dcf7d817d4b62cec033ba77fa8e2a5ec/ofl/exo2

The upstream TTF files were converted to WOFF2 with FontTools 4.68.0 and
Brotli 1.2.1. Exo 2's weight axis was fixed at 800 before conversion.
All upstream glyphs are retained. No commercial PDF fonts are redistributed.
